title: AID IR v0.2
description: The packed intermediate representation produced from an AID spec document. Every top-level key is always present; deferred collections are empty arrays in Phase 0 rather than absent.

irVersion.description: Semver of the IR format, independent of specVersion.

specVersion.description: The spec language version this IR was built from.

profile.description: The delivery profile the spec selected. Always present: a spec that names no profile is `standard`, so the requirement set a build is measured against is never implicit.

resolved.description: False when the name matches no entry in `types`; the referential gate rejects those.

policyExpr.description: A parsed PolicyExpr node. Operands recurse, so the shape is validated structurally rather than exhaustively.
policyExpr.$comment: Intentionally loose: the AST's `kind` discriminator is enforced, the recursive operand shape is checked by the parser that produced it.

requiresApproval.description: Whether the run pauses for a human before this step executes. The gate refuses it on a tool with no side effects and on a document with no durable store to hold the pause.

oneOf.description: Authorization branching: runs one of two step lists. `when` reads the caller's Principal and never a context value, because the policy grammar has no operand for one.

else.description: Empty when the spec declared no alternative, so a false predicate runs nothing and the branch binds nothing.

oneOf.description: Runs every arm concurrently under the deployment's one cap and merges their bindings in branch order.
Applies one step to every item of a bound list and binds the ordered list of results.
Applies one prompt to every item of a bound list and binds the ordered list of replies.
Asks one `choice` decision which arm to run and runs that arm. Every label the decision can answer is mapped unless `default` catches the rest.

input.description: Template over earlier bindings; the rendered text is what the decision classifies.

as.description: Binds the label that was answered, including one that fell through to `default`.

oneOf.description: Reorders the retrieval result bound by `over` against `query`. A leaf: it nests no steps.

model.description: Reranker alias matched by the runtime, not a models[] id, so it is looser than an identifier.

oneOf.description: Runs one declared guardrail at one stage. Binds nothing: a `flag` is observability only.

text.description: Template text at input/output; a single reference to a retrieval binding at retrieval.

oneOf.description: Runs a declared agent to completion and binds its answer. A leaf: it opens no thread and resumes nothing.

stepList.description: A step list nested inside a composite. Non-empty: an arm that runs nothing is one the author should delete, not a no-op to emit.

export.description: Where spans go. Absent when no document declared it, which is what every document before spec 0.27 meant, so the property is written only when it was stated.

endpointEnv.description: The name of the environment variable holding the collector address, never the address itself.

feedback.description: The feedback intake. Declared once for the process, so a pipeline never carries one; absent unless a document declared it.

alerts.description: The alarm policies the document declared. Absent unless it declared at least one, so a document that declared none keeps the IR it had.

valid.description: False when `qualified` is not a `kind:id` pair with a known kind; the referential gate rejects those.

predicate.description: A parsed PredicateExpr AST. Recursive and closed. There is no `invalid` arm: a build that cannot parse the predicate fails instead of emitting a node no evaluator could score.

minMean.description: Absolute floor on the mean of every metric, checked before the maxRegression delta. An eval carrying an assert must declare 1.0, since a false assertion is not sampling noise.

promotion.description: The policy `aid eval --compare` applies to two recorded baselines. Absent unless a document declared one, so every eval built before spec 0.28 serializes byte-identically.

agentState.description: A durable run store. `urlEnv` names an environment variable, never a connection string, so no credential enters the IR.

urlEnv.description: An environment variable name, uppercase by convention like `apiKeyEnv`, never a connection string.

deploymentIdentity.description: The identity provider a deployment checks tokens against. A reference -- issuer URL and claim names -- so signature verification stays with the keys the customer's IdP owns.

deploymentNetwork.description: Where the workload runs and what it may reach. `private` is required so the IR never implies a placement the spec did not ask for.

deploymentApprovals.description: Change control, not runtime human-in-the-loop: who must sign off before a change to this environment lands. Both fields are required so a policy cannot name no one.

audit.description: Where a deployment's audit trail is written. The sink vocabulary is wider than any one cloud on purpose; the `region` and `audit` gates pair it with the cloud actually selected.

cloud.description: The cloud this deployment is placed in. Absent when the spec names none, so the environment's `--cloud` (or `aws`) still decides and existing output is byte-identical.

region.description: The region pinned by the spec. Validated against the selected cloud; it is a placement fact carried to the plan, not module content.

image.description: Where the image for this deployment is published; only a container deployment can carry one. `loginServer` and `loginFields` are present only when the registry's host or credential is derived from declared fields, so a `ghcr.io` or `docker.io` image serializes exactly as it did before a cloud registry existed.

pipeline.description: Id of the pipeline a `batch` job runs to completion; required on that target and absent on every other.
